events.label: birth
events.text: Born in Torre Pelosa near Bari, Italy.

evidence.quote: Licia Albanese ( July 22 , 1909 – August 15 , 2014 ) was an Italian-born American operatic soprano
Felicia Albanese was born in July 1909 in Torre Pelosa
